summary: iter197 — End-to-end verification of (a) Pilot Welcome Banner on Seller Dashboard with dismiss + 7-day auto-hide gating, (b) Admin Dashboard Pending Reviews / Disputes / Currency Appeals KPI cards with hide-when-zero behavior, (c) seller.user_id projection on GET /api/vehicles/{id}, and (d) iter196 messaging-gate regression. 7/7 new pytest assertions on counter endpoints + 14/14 iter196 regression tests pass. Frontend Playwright validated banner FR title 'Bienvenue au pilote BidVex, Iter189 !', dismiss button writes localStorage 'bidvex.pilot_welcome.dismissed'='1' and banner stays hidden after reload, all 3 admin KPI cards visible+colored when count=1 and ALL hidden (incl. red dot on Vehicles tab) when counts mocked to 0 and page reloaded.

integration_issues.issue: CTA button 'Inscrire mon premier véhicule' navigates to /vehicle-auctions/create as coded, but the route guard immediately redirects to /vehicle-auctions/seller/register because the test buyer has not yet completed vehicle-seller registration. The banner code matches the spec; the redirect is downstream app behavior. Worth confirming with main agent that the dealer-license approval path also auto-creates a vehicle_seller doc — otherwise a freshly-approved pilot dealer will be bounced from the CTA into the seller-registration flow rather than the listing-creation flow.

action_items: (Recommended) Verify that approving a dealer_license also auto-creates the vehicle_seller record so the pilot CTA's /vehicle-auctions/create destination is reachable without a separate registration step. Otherwise the banner CTA UX is mismatched with spec.

(Optional) Seed at least one vehicle_listing where winner_id matches a known test buyer and unlock_paid_at is set, so the VehicleDetailPage 'Message Dealer' button can be Playwright-tested in the preview env (currently 0 vehicles in DB).

VehicleDetailPage.js:1205-1240 — The 4-clause AND gate (user, vehicle.winner_id===user.id, vehicle.unlock_paid_at, seller.user_id) is correctly applied; modal mount at line 1354 also re-checks seller?.user_id as a defense-in-depth.

routes/misc.py:622 — admin_currency_appeals_pending_count uses get_current_user with manual role check; routes/vehicle_settlement.py:649 uses _require_admin dependency. Consider unifying for consistency.
routes/vehicles.py:1009 — The seller projection now correctly includes user_id alongside id. ✓
